'''Aburrey Sensor Chip''' is a {{gear|4|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Novel protective equipment modified to suit the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry.
